integrity: All reported finite computations use exact quadratic rational arithmetic, exact integer Smith forms from two equation lists, a labelled graph isomorphism, and independent prime-local elimination. All packaged file bytes are SHA-256 checked.
scientific_limitations: The invariant is the graph critical group of a specific 49-vertex Klein incidence Levi graph over characteristic zero, not the smooth quartic Jacobian; a directly relevant 1994 paper is accessible only by abstract/metadata, leaving priority provisional.
title: The integral graph Jacobian of the Klein 28–21 bitangent incidence configuration
